items.title: Novartis targets undruggable cancers with $1.9bn Antares Therapeutics deal
items.summary: Antares’ lead precision oncology programme is expected to enter the clinic in 2026.

items.title: ŌURA and Lilly join forces to harmonise drug-wearable obesity care
items.summary: Lilly and ŌURA's partnership marks another high-profile collaboration between the consumer health and life science sectors.

items.title: Boehringer and Combotope partner for cancer antibodies
items.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has collaborated with Combotope Therapeutics to advance tumour-selective antibody therapies targeting cancer.

items.title: Haisco and Nuvectis sign licensing deal for two drugs
items.summary: Haisco has signed an exclusive licensing agreement granting Nuvectis rights for two drug candidates in oncology and complement indications.

items.title: BIO 2026: NVIDIA announces the BioNeMo toolkit for AI agents
items.summary: The suite of tools is designed to allow AI to carry out R&D work more quickly, reliably, and in a continuous innovation loop.
